messages:
Maria G: Heads-up: post-merge canary shows a 10–15% P99 increase on INT8 profiles in eu-west after merge abc1234. KV cache miss rate appears up ~3x. Saw it during traffic test at 09:12 UTC.
perf-ci: [alert] perf-ci detected regression for eng-runtime/int8-canary: P99 +12% vs baseline. Link: https://perf.ci/runs/5423 :warning:
Kevin L: @Maria G can you paste the telemetry histograms? Also did CPU/GPU metrics change?
Maria G: GPU util roughly the same, CPU fine. grabbing histos...
Maria G: ```
kv_cache_hit_rate: baseline 0.92 -> canary 0.67
avg_dequant_time_per_token_ms: baseline 0.12 -> canary 0.36
route_fallback_count: baseline 120 -> canary 820
```
Arjun S: wow fallback_count jumps. Did kernel selector or routing heuristics change in that merge?
Maria G: yes, merge abc1234 (PR #4220) lowered the fallback soft-threshold from 0.7 -> 0.5 and enabled the 'aggressive-routing' heuristic.
Sam T: lowering the threshold will definitely increase fallbacks and could explain KV churn.
Kevin L: can someone reproduce with loadgen locally? @Sam T @Arjun S
Sam T: running loadgen against the canary image now, will post a short flamegraph.
Sam T: ```
flamegraph snippet:
  dequant_hotloop -> 48% CPU
  kv_cache_lookup -> increased wall time
```
Maria G: I ran a quick git bisect earlier: first bad commit is abc1234 (PR #4220). It bundles kernel selection tweaks + the threshold change.
Kevin L: Two options: revert PR 4220 entirely, or roll forward with a conservative config change (restore fallback_threshold to 0.75). Risk assessment?
Arjun S: restoring threshold should reduce fallbacks and KV churn. It might re-expose some slow kernels we tried to avoid, but on our evals quality impact is minimal.
Maria G: ran evals — no quality hit when threshold set to 0.75 on our sampled prompts.
Kevin L: OK prepare a hotfix: config rollback + pause canary. @deploy-bot can you hold canary traffic and open a rollback PR?
deploy-bot: Pausing canary traffic to cluster eu-west-1. Created ticket RW-1934 and PR https://git.redwood/infra/PR-4231 to set fallback_threshold=0.75 :white_check_mark:
perf-ci: Re-run scheduled for PR-4231. Will post perf diff in ~20m.
Sam T: re-ran loadgen against PR-4231, initial numbers: P99 back within baseline +-2%.
Maria G: Thanks — leaving canary paused and running extended soak. If stable for 1h we'll promote. I'll draft a short postmortem after.
Kevin L: Add rollout checklist to PR and ping release engineering. :memo:
Arjun S: Follow-up item: add telemetry counters per-threshold-change and a CI assertion to catch large fallback_count deltas.
Maria G: +1, opening issue RW-1935 to add CI gate for fallback_count regressions.
Sam T: tagging perf owners @Kevin L @Arjun S
Maria G: Closing loop for now. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
